title: Running in the GENERALI BERLIN-MARATHON – registration and entry
claims: Race entries for the GENERALI BERLIN-MARATHON are allocated by lottery.
The lottery registration period is 1 October 2026 to 12 November 2026, and results are announced on 3 December 2026.
The participation fee is 215 euros, charged only if an entry is assigned.

The entry fee includes a 4-day public transport pass for fare zones A, B and C, pacemakers in all starting waves, a personalised finisher certificate, a poncho or a clothing-bag service for 5 euros, and massage services along the course and in the finish area.
Runners born in 2009 or earlier are eligible; Nordic walkers are not permitted, while walkers are permitted within the time limit.
The event is organised under the regulations of the German Athletics Association (DLV) and World Athletics, supervised by the Berlin Athletics Association (BLV).
The entry page says the organiser's medical team and additional paramedics are authorized and obligated to remove runners from the race who are hurt or overexerting.
Fast-runner qualifying times range from 2:45 to 3:25 for men and from 3:10 to 4:20 for women depending on age group, with marathon proof no older than two years.
Fifty runners holding a Sozialticket S can buy an entry for 50 euros.
Starting spots are assigned to specific individuals and may not be transferred to another person or year.
